create_lasso_lars_ic_model: create a Lasso model using LARS with AIC or BIC criterion to select the optimal regularization parameter alpha
select_lasso_via_cross_validation: select the best Lasso model hyperparameter using cross-validation with coordinate descent solver
select_lasso_via_least_angle_regression: select the best Lasso model hyperparameter using cross-validation with least angle regression solver
compare_information_criterion_and_cv: compare AIC-BIC information criterion and cross-validation strategies for Lasso model selection
plot_lasso_model_selection_results: plot AIC and BIC criteria values across alpha values with selected optimal alpha estimates for Lasso model selection
